title: clerical: TKT-006 cycle closure — status flips + BACKLOG-002
body:
## Summary

Clerical closure of the TKT-006 (Food Lookup KBJU Estimator) cycle following RV-CODE-006 iter-2 verdict `pass` (commit `754d87b`) and Executor's iter-2 fix push (commit `528fa42`, rebased onto post-PR #46 main).

Three changes — all clerical / orchestrator-write-zone:

| File | Change | Field-level diff |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/tickets/TKT-006-food-lookup-kbju-estimator.md` | frontmatter only | `status: in_review → done`, `updated: 2026-04-30`, add `completed_at`, `completed_by`, `completed_note` |
| `docs/reviews/RV-CODE-006-tkt-006-food-lookup-kbju-estimator.md` | frontmatter only | `status: in_review → approved`, add `updated`, `approved_at`, `approved_after_iters: 2`, `approved_by`, `approved_note`, `superseded_by: null` |
| `docs/backlog/food-lookup-followups.md` | **new file** (BACKLOG-002@0.1.0) | TKT-NEW-E (F-L1 dead `isPromptOrResponseSafeForLogging`), TKT-NEW-F (F-L2 deep-freeze `MANUAL_ENTRY_FAILURE_RESULT`), TKT-NEW-G (F-L3 decouple `LLM_TIMEOUT_MS`) |

No source-code changes. No body edits to artifact bodies. Validator: `validated 46 artifact(s); 0 failed` (45 from main + 1 new BACKLOG-002).

## TKT-006 cycle recap

- **Iter-1 (Executor):** PR #42 commit `8a9175b` (fork from `ba038d5`) — implementation of C6 KBJU estimator, hybrid lookup OFF→USDA→LLM, OmniRoute routing, prompt-injection guards. 281/281 tests.
- **Iter-1 (Reviewer):** RV-CODE-006 commit `8a9175b8` (Kimi K2.6) — verdict `pass_with_changes`, 3 medium + 3 low findings.
- **PO decision:** Option A (fix M, defer L) on 2026-04-30.
- **Iter-2 (Executor):** PR #42 commit `08cec21` → rebased to `528fa42` after PR-Agent integration landed on main. F-M1 Russian/Cyrillic patterns, F-M2 500ms HTTP 429 backoff, F-M3 promise-chain mutex per client. 291/291 tests (+10 net).
- **Iter-2 (Reviewer):** RV-CODE-006 commit `754d87b` — verdict `pass`, all 3 medium RESOLVED with file:line citations against `08cec21`.
- **Merge:** PR #42 squash `a8a9f35` (TKT-006 code), PR #44 squash `a0862bd` (RV-CODE-006 review file).

## BACKLOG-002 contents (preview)

Three follow-up TKT entries, each with: source finding ref, the issue, proposed fix (Architect to ratify), out-of-scope items, estimated size (XS each), dependencies (none). Promotion to TKT happens when the Architect produces an ArchSpec section that covers the item — same convention as BACKLOG-001 §TKT-NEW-A/B (post TKT-005).

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

Risk: green — clerical-only PR within Orchestrator write-zone (per `CONTRIBUTING.md` Roles row).

- [ ] Validator green: `python3 scripts/validate_docs.py` reports `validated 46 artifact(s); 0 failed`. (Verified locally.)
- [ ] CI `validate-docs` ✅.
- [ ] BACKLOG-002 frontmatter follows BACKLOG-001 schema (`id`, `title`, `status: open`, `spec_ref: ARCH-001@0.4.0`, `created`).
- [ ] Squash-merge with default title to keep linear history. After merge, the `auto-cold` rule (per `docs/session-log/README.md`) triggers — orchestrator will open a separate session-log PR (`session-log: auto-cold after TKT-006 cycle close`) covering both ADR-010 + TKT-006 cycles + PR-Agent integration without further PO request.

### Notes

- **Why not also bump `ARCH-001@0.4.0` review_refs?** ARCH-001's `review_refs` track SPEC reviews of ARCH-001 itself (e.g. RV-SPEC-005 ratifying ARCH-001@0.4.0 cascade). RV-CODE-006 is a CODE review of TKT-006, not a review of ARCH-001 — no cascade needed.
- **Why is `PR-Agent supplementary review` mentioned in `approved_note`?** Documents the audit trail that Kimi K2.6 was the load-bearing CODE-mode reviewer; PR-Agent (then on old pre-PR #47 config) posted `Failed to generate code suggestions for PR` with no substantive findings — i.e. nothing additional was deferred from PR-Agent feedback.
- **No body edits to TKT-006 §10 Execution Log:** Executor (GLM) appended log entries during iter-1 and iter-2 directly. Orchestrator's clerical zone covers frontmatter only; body is read-only here.
